overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing colonist psychology state transitions for zero-latency updates, and enabling atomic endgame ascension logic with minimal memory footprint.

tasks.title: Deterministic State Hashing for Save/Load Integrity
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a constexpr-friendly, zero-heap hash function using FNV-1a 64-bit. Input: contiguous byte array of simulation state. Output: uint64_t hash. Use std::span for input. No dynamic allocation. Handle endianness explicitly via std::endian::native. Include static_assert for hash consistency on known test vectors. Max 40 lines.
acceptance_criteria: Hash function returns identical uint64_t for identical state sequences across platforms.
Unit tests pass for 1000 random state permutations.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures reliable save/load cycles, preventing corruption and enabling quick-resume gameplay.

tasks.title: Atomic Colonist Psychology State Transition Table
tasks.architectural_spec: Define a static constexpr array of 16 psychology states (e.g., Idle, Working, Resting, Panicked) and their valid transitions. Use std::array<std::pair<uint8_t, uint8_t>, 32> for transition pairs. Implement a constexpr lookup function: uint8_t NextState(uint8_t current, uint8_t event). No virtual functions. No std::map. Max 50 lines.
acceptance_criteria: All 16 states have defined transitions for 4 core events.
Lookup is O(1) via direct array indexing.
No undefined behavior in state transitions.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster simulation ticks, smoother colonist behavior, and reduced frame stutter.

tasks.title: Endgame Ascension Flag Compression
tasks.architectural_spec: Use a single uint64_t bitmask to store 64 endgame flags (e.g., CompletedTutorial, UnlockedTech1, etc.). Provide constexpr get/set/clear functions using bitwise operations. No std::bitset. No dynamic memory. Include static_assert for flag count <= 64. Max 30 lines.
acceptance_criteria: All 64 flags fit in one uint64_t.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster save file loading and smaller save file size.
